search.query: | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | append [ | inputlookup ctf_answers | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" ] | eval NiceStartTime=strftime(StartTime,"%+") | eval NiceEndTime=strftime(EndTime,"%+") | stats last(Question) as Question last(Answer) as Answer last(BasePoints) as BasePoints last(NiceStartTime) as Start last(NiceEndTime) as End by ctf_id Number | sort Number
